extraction_issues.reason: The paper reports colony-count survival/killing assays and microscopy, not MIC/MBC or hemolysis/cytotoxicity tables.

The local XML, PDF text, OA NXML, package images, and indexed supplementary landing assets support assay conditions, thresholds, qualitative killing claims, and figure curves, but no local table/spreadsheet/source text contains exact point-level cell-survival values or SEMs for every Figure 4 and Figure 5 dose/time point. Digitizing plotted points would create approximate values, not source-tabulated exact values.
